playbookOutputs: SARS RLA Trade Agreement Producer/Exporter Registration (DA 185.4A2 / DA 185.4A7) & Origin Motivation Pack
Completed & Validated Certificate of Origin (SADC / EUR.1 / AfCFTA) Dossier Ready for Customs / Chamber Stamping
playbookCommonFailures: Exporter is registered for a basic Customs Code (DA 185.4A2) but has not activated the specific Trade Agreement annexure (SADC / EPA / AfCFTA) on SARS RLA
Imported raw material percentage exceeds the maximum non-originating content threshold for the HS tariff heading

informationToProvide.label: SARS Customs Exporter Code Number, Target Trade Agreement (SADC / EUR.1 / AfCFTA / AGOA) & Destination Country
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide your 8-digit SARS Customs Exporter Code, which preferential trade agreement Certificate of Origin is needed (SADC, EUR.1/EPA, AfCFTA, or AGOA), and the destination country.

informationToProvide.label: Export Product Description & 8-Digit Harmonized System (HS) Tariff Codes
informationToProvide.helpText: Describe the goods being exported and list their 8-digit SARS Customs HS tariff codes.

informationToProvide.label: Commercial Export Invoice & Packing List
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the commercial export invoice and packing list showing consignee details, quantities, weights, and invoice values.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Commercial export invoice and packing list in the exporter name showing consignee, HS codes, quantities, weights, and FOB/CIF values.

informationToProvide.label: Manufacturing Cost Breakdown / Bill of Materials / Local Producer Declaration Proving SA Origin
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the manufacturing cost breakdown or supplier origin declarations proving the goods are wholly obtained or sufficiently worked in South Africa.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bill of materials, manufacturing cost breakdown, or supplier declaration proving South African originating status under the trade agreement rules of origin.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling / RLA Customs Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling username linked to Registration, Licensing and Accreditation (RLA) for Trade Agreements.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect exporter code, HS tariff codes, and costing files
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Origin rules verified against specific trade agreement

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compile DA 185, DA 185.4A2, and origin motivation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs application forms and local content schedules drafted

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit application via SARS eFiling / Customs Hub
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Submitted to SARS Customs Trade Agreements division

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver trade agreement registration confirmation & certificate template
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Delivered to client with instructions on stamping certificates for export shipments
